packageRules.description: Mirror the 7-day soak pnpm enforces in clients/ts/pnpm-workspace.yaml (minimumReleaseAge: 10080). Without it Renovate proposes versions pnpm refuses to resolve, so it cannot regenerate pnpm-lock.yaml and CI fails on ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE.

typescript-eslint hard-errors on a TypeScript major it does not support yet, so such a bump cannot pass CI however long it waits. Park it on the dependency dashboard and approve it once typescript-eslint catches up.
